subject: Whiteboard readout + resource nominations for QBR
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Liu <jamie@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Whiteboard readout + resource nominations for QBR

Team —

Quick readout from yesterday's whiteboard session with Product and Sales about the QBR narrative. High level: the deck will call out three customer-facing pillars for next quarter (latency SLO tightening, Dedicated onboarding flow, and cost-per-token improvements). To hit the QBR asks we need two short-term scope trims and a handful of named resource nominations.

Asks:
- Can each of you nominate 1 engineer (or owner) who can be seconded for 4–6 weeks to help with the Dedicated onboarding checklist and one person for the latency playbook? We need names by EOD Thursday.
- Markus — can infra own a fallback runbook for the rollout if the quantized variants show quality regressions? A one-pager is fine.
- Naomi — attaching the whiteboard export and dependency register (draft). Please add any missing external constraints.

Attached: QBR-whiteboard-notes.pdf (whiteboard summary), dependency-register.xlsx (live dependencies).

Proposed next step: 30-min async readout on Friday (short Loom + comments) so we can lock the deck bullets. If any blockers require synchronous triage, call it out here.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whiteboard readout + resource nominations for QBR

On Tue, Sep 14, 2026 at 9:17 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick readout from yesterday's whiteboard session with Product and Sales about the QBR narrative. High level: the deck will call out three customer-facing pillars for next quarter (latency SLO tightening, Dedicated onboarding flow, and cost-per-token improvements). To hit the QBR asks we need two short-term scope trims and a handful of named resource nominations.

Thanks for the summary. I'm OK to nominate people but want to flag a risk: Dedicated onboarding depends on a security completion item from Acme (SAML metadata and a signed CSA). I've added a row in dependency-register.xlsx and pinged Jamie to confirm timeline.

Nominations (tentative):
- Dedicated onboarding owner: Priya N. (can be full-time for first 3 weeks, then part-time)
- Latency playbook SME: Karthik I. (can pair with Markus' infra lead)

I agree a Loom readout + comments is the right next step — I'll capture the pending external requirements in the dependency sheet and set a hard guardrail: if Acme's security sign-off slips beyond 10/05 we'll recommend a scoped demo instead of a full onboarding story in the QBR.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whiteboard readout + resource nominations for QBR

Marissa / team —

On the fallback runbook: yes, infra can own the initial draft. I'll put together a short playbook that covers:
1) rollback steps for model variant swaps,
2) KV-cache re-seeding procedure,
3) quick-telemetry checks (latency, error-rate delta, top-k token divergence), and
4) communication templates for sales & CS.

I'll need one SWE to help validate the KV re-seed tests and someone from Observability to wire the telemetry checks. If Naomi's Priya is seconded we can run validation in week two. Tentative owners:
- Engineering validation: Rishi M.
- Observability wiring: Laura B. (can be 20% effort)

I'll upload the one-pager by EOD Thursday. If we need an exec signoff path for emergency failover after-hours, we should list that in the runbook (who to call, who can approve fallback).

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whiteboard readout + resource nominations for QBR

Thanks — this is moving in the right direction. Short checklist before the Friday Loom:
- Naomi: finalize nominations and mark availability in the sheet (Priya and Karthik confirmed tentatively). Add a hard cut date for Acme sign-off as a gating item.
- Markus: upload the fallback runbook draft and the emergency exec contact flow.
- Laura: can you block 4 hrs next week for Observability wiring (spread across team)? If yes, add the ticket IDs to the dependency sheet.
- Vanessa: please align with Sales on the narrative we push to Acme — if we shift to a scoped demo due to sign-off delays, we need a different slide set.

If everyone can hit those by COB Monday I'll convert the whiteboard summary into two deck bullets (customer asks vs what we'll demo) and route to Exec for the QBR dry run.

One more thing: I CC'd Jamie to keep Acme in the loop. Jamie — if you can confirm the SAML metadata timeline and whether ProcureOps needs a separate PO number for Dedicated trials, that'd be great.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
